skill.name: dast-nuclei
skill.description: Run authorized Nuclei DAST scans for web applications, APIs, and infrastructure. The skill guides target scoping, template selection, authenticated scanning, CI integration, triage, and reporting.
skill.summary: Run authorized ProjectDiscovery Nuclei scans with scope, rate limits, authentication, CI workflows, and triage guidance.
skill.author: AgentSecOps

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are expected Nuclei commands, reference URLs, and educational vulnerability examples. One CI template includes an unpinned remote install script piped to bash. The skill should publish only after CI supply-chain examples and credential-handling guidance are hardened.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly to bash in the CI template.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-bash with a pinned package, pinned action, checksum verification, or vendored installer instructions.

remediation.issue: CI examples use mutable action refs such as @main and @master.
remediation.suggestion: Pin third-party GitHub Actions to immutable commit SHAs or reviewed release tags.

remediation.issue: Authenticated scan examples pass tokens and cookies through command-line headers.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer Nuclei config files, CI secret injection, short-lived tokens, masked logs, and clear cleanup guidance.

content.value_statement: Security teams need fast checks for known vulnerabilities across applications and APIs. This skill guides authorized Nuclei scans, CI workflows, triage, and reporting.
actual_capabilities: Guide Nuclei installation, template updates, and basic target scans.
Select templates by severity, tags, CVE focus, OWASP coverage, and technology stack.
Configure rate limits, concurrency, timeouts, output formats, and SARIF export.
Plan authenticated scans with bearer tokens, cookies, OAuth, SAML, and MFA patterns.
Triage scan results, reduce false positives, map findings to OWASP and CWE, and prepare reports.
limitations: It does not grant permission to scan systems outside an approved scope.
It depends on Nuclei and any local scripts or CI runners being installed separately.
Automated results still need manual validation before incident escalation.
Template coverage depends on current Nuclei community templates and custom rule quality.

use_cases.title: Scan Staging Before Release
use_cases.description: Run scoped Nuclei checks against staging services before deployment and export findings for review.

use_cases.title: Add CI Vulnerability Gates
use_cases.description: Create CI jobs that scan approved targets and fail builds on critical findings.

use_cases.title: Build Custom Detection Templates
use_cases.description: Author and test organization-specific Nuclei templates for APIs, exposures, and misconfigurations.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Safe First Scan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for one approved target.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a conservative Nuclei scan for this approved target: [target]. Include scope, severity, rate limits, and output files.

prompt_templates.title: Triage Scan Results
prompt_templates.scenario: Review findings after a scan completes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these Nuclei findings and help me group them by severity, likely false positives, OWASP category, and required validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create a CI Scan Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Add automated scanning to a repository.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a GitHub Actions workflow for Nuclei scanning of staging. Use pinned actions, secrets, SARIF upload, artifacts, and critical-only build failure.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Custom Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced template authoring for an internal risk.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a Nuclei template for this authorized detection goal: [goal]. Include matchers, false-positive controls, rate limits, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: A request to scan one approved staging URL for critical and high issues.
output_examples.output: A scan plan with target scope, selected severities, conservative rate limits, output names, and manual validation steps.

output_examples.input: A list of Nuclei findings from a CI run.
output_examples.output: A triage summary grouped by severity, suspected false positives, owner recommendations, and remediation priority.

output_examples.input: A request to add Nuclei to a release pipeline.
output_examples.output: A workflow design that uses pinned actions, secret-backed authentication, SARIF upload, retained artifacts, and clear failure conditions.

best_practices: Confirm written authorization and target scope before every scan.
Start with conservative rate limits and critical or high severity templates.
Validate critical findings manually before creating incidents or blocking releases.
anti_patterns: Do not scan third-party or production systems without explicit approval.
Do not paste real tokens, cookies, or private URLs into shared prompts or reports.
Do not treat automated Nuclei results as confirmed vulnerabilities without validation.

faq.question: Does this skill run Nuclei by itself?
faq.answer: It guides the agent or user through Nuclei commands and workflows. Nuclei must be installed in the environment.

faq.question: Can I use it for production scanning?
faq.answer: Yes, only with approval and conservative settings. Use low concurrency, rate limits, and clearly defined exclusions.

faq.question: Does it support authenticated scanning?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers bearer tokens, cookies, OAuth, SAML, and MFA patterns using secrets or environment variables.

faq.question: Can it reduce false positives?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes triage steps, verification guidance, template filtering, and OWASP or CWE mapping.

faq.question: Can it create custom Nuclei templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains template structure, matchers, extractors, payloads, validation, and responsible testing parameters.

faq.question: Is this a replacement for manual testing?
faq.answer: No. It accelerates coverage for known patterns, but critical findings still need expert verification.
